title: StockSmart Credit Desk Schedule — Release from Payments Received in the Latest Month
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — first customer-owned fill of a bin converted from consignment, booked while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold.**

**Rule.** Payments the customer's Commercial Credit Account received in the latest month (rows of age zero, a row's age in whole months being the calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than its day) add a release of 1 percent of their total where that total is 50000.00 USD or more, 0.5 percent where it is 10000.00 USD or more but below 50000.00 USD, and none below that.

Payments are counted by their transaction date on the Commercial Credit Account.

| Payments received in the latest month, total USD | Release |
|---|---|
| 50000.00 or more | 1 percent of the total |
| 10000.00 or more, below 50000.00 | 0.5 percent of the total |
| below 10000.00 | none |

**Hypothetical totals.** 50000.00 releases 500.00; 49999.00 releases 249.995; 10000.00 releases 50.00; 9999.00 releases nothing.

**Hypothetical window.** With today on 10 May, a payment dated 11 April is of age zero and counts; one dated 10 April is of age one and does not.
